input._script:
using CUDA
using JSON3

result = Dict{String,Any}()
input = JSON3.read(ARGS[1])
a_host = Float32.(input.a)
b_host = Float32.(input.b)
n = length(a_host)

# --- raw CUDA.jl ---
try
    if !CUDA.functional()
        result["cuda"] = Dict("error" => "CUDA is not functional on this node")
    else
        function vadd_kernel!(y, a, b)
            i = (blockIdx().x - 1) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x
            if i <= length(y)
                @inbounds y[i] = a[i] + b[i]
            end
            return nothing
        end
        a_dev = CuArray(a_host)
        b_dev = CuArray(b_host)
        y_dev = CUDA.zeros(Float32, n)
        threads = 256
        blocks = cld(n, threads)
        @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks vadd_kernel!(y_dev, a_dev, b_dev)
        CUDA.synchronize()
        result["cuda"] = Dict("result" => Array(y_dev), "device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()))
    end
catch e
    result["cuda"] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
end

# --- JACC.jl (unverified convention, see this file's header comment) ---
try
    ENV["JACC_BACKEND"] = "CUDA"
    import JACC
    JACC.@init_backend
    a_j = JACC.Array(a_host)
    b_j = JACC.Array(b_host)
    y_j = JACC.Array(zeros(Float32, n))
    JACC.@parallel_for range=n (i) -> begin
        y_j[i] = a_j[i] + b_j[i]
    end
    result["jacc"] = Dict("result" => Array(y_j))
catch e
    result["jacc"] = Dict("error" => sprint(showerror, e))
end

println(JSON3.write(result))
